explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 53 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across Pitchfork's September 9–10, 2026 electronic reviews and current news, September 11 Bandcamp label releases from ARTS and trau-ma, retailer metadata, and overlooked exact odd-meter electronic catalogue; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and prior unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.
Recently decided Bitchin Bajas, Argento, FAUZIA, Container, DJ POPS, South Beach Recycling and DJ Phil fields were screened but excluded.
Current release-context-only leads explicitly preserve the absence of exact-track mechanics; genre tags, metadata, novelty and artist reputation are not treated as admission evidence.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: September 11 Bandcamp pages for Sanskrit's Ultramarine EP and Norberto Lusso's Akeem supplied eight exact current tracks across ARTS and trau-ma; Pitchfork's September 2026 Andy Stott announcement supplied a current constrained-production single. https://artsrecordings.bandcamp.com/album/ultramarine-ep ; https://trau-ma.bandcamp.com/album/akeem ; https://pitchfork.com/story/andy-stott-returns-with-first-album-in-five-years

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Sanskrit's raw/deep techno release, Norberto Lusso's current hypnotic-techno release and Andy Stott's bassline-free, reverb-free delay-only production frame supplied materially different routes without assuming one sonic room.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Beverly Glenn-Copeland's River Dreams has artist-attributed 17/8 structure; TJO's Juno has exact criticism describing a beat entering in a different time signature from its modal opening. https://pitchfork.com/news/beverly-glenn-copeland-announces-new-album-transmissions-shares-new-song-listen ; https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/6002-tjo-tko

FRESHNESS CHECK: repository searches found no durable exact decision, revisit, utility or unresolved entry for the nine requested identities. Previously decided Bitchin Bajas tracks, the physical-only Watch Your Step lead, Argento's recorded Mare Arcaico alternate and the Miraggi watch were excluded.
